title: Fan-in of a bit block
statement: Let $a,b,c,\mathrm{cin},\mathrm{acc},L$ be natural numbers with $a\ne b$, $c<L$, $\mathrm{cin}<L$, and $\mathrm{acc}<L$. Every gate in the corresponding bit block is well formed and has at most two inputs.
